summary: Validated new buyer-counter endpoint + removal of refuse-counter across backend (pytest 13/13) and frontend (Playwright). Ping-pong negotiation OK: offer_sent→counter→buyer-counter→counter→accept-counter transitions verified with correct amounts. Backend regressions (withdraw-offer, accept-counter, seller refuse) still pass. Frontend on offer_countered shows btn-accept-counter + btn-buyer-counter (no btn-refuse-counter); clicking btn-buyer-counter opens modal 'Nouvelle proposition' with counter-amount/counter-message/counter-submit; submitting flips backend to offer_sent with new offer_amount.
critical_code_review_comments: CitadelleTransactionDetail.js is still ~1040 lines — should be split (>700 line guideline). Not blocking.

buyer_counter_offer overwrites offer_message with the new proposition message (fine, but there's no historical trace of the first buyer message beyond what's already in messages[])—current behavior is acceptable because full history is preserved in messages array.
Consider adding a unit assertion in backend that offer_amount > 0 explicitly returns 422 (currently CounterOffer Pydantic validator handles it — verified indirectly).
